requirements.description: Produce an inspectable instance JSON grounded in library pieces and expose unresolved boundaries.
Accept a support ticket for assessment.
Assess ticket intent and urgency under an agreed policy; retain uncertainty.
Prepare an appropriate response draft using the ticket and its assessment.
Define human review and escalation before any external action.

entities.name: Ticket triage lifecycle
entities.description: Proposed lifecycle: receive a ticket, assess it, prepare a draft, and apply a review decision. Review and escalation rules remain open.

entities.name: Assess → draft
entities.description: Proposed ordering of two local composites. The assessment Message must preserve the original ticket; that behavior has no evidence yet.

entities.name: Ticket assessment
entities.description: Represent the same Chat Input and assessment Agent occurrences as one local capability.

entities.name: Response drafting
entities.description: Represent the response Agent and Chat Output occurrences without duplicating them.

entities.name: Ticket input
entities.description: Pinned Chat Input definition. Manual entry is a proposal pending channel confirmation.

entities.name: Assessment agent
entities.description: Pinned Agent interface; instructions describe intended behavior, not proven capability.

configuration.system_prompt: Assess the supplied ticket using the agreed policy. Preserve its original text in the assessment for downstream drafting. If the policy or facts are insufficient, state the uncertainty. Return assessment and original ticket.

entities.name: Drafting agent
entities.description: A separate Agent occurrence referencing the same definition version. No tools are attached and no message is sent externally.

configuration.system_prompt: Prepare a response draft from the original ticket and its assessment. Do not invent missing facts or claim external actions. Flag uncertainty for human review.

entities.name: Draft output
entities.description: Pinned Chat Output definition; displays a Message. It is not an outbound ticket-system integration.

entities.name: Existing model configuration
entities.description: Bind an existing Langflow model configuration, optionally API Proxy. No credential, token or private authentication data is copied.

entities.name: Review and escalation policy
entities.description: A proposed human decision boundary, not a fabricated executable component.
